title: 100% tariffs on India? Russia sanctions bill passed by US House; awaits Trump’s sign
content: The US House has successfully passed a sanctions bill aimed at Russian officials and the energy sector. This new legislation empowers President Trump to impose tariffs on significant buyers of Russian oil. India might encounter a staggering 100 percent tariff on its imports due to its energy dealings with Russia. The bill also broadens sanctions against Russia and prolongs measures against Iran for an additional five years.

title: 'Very political': Trump fumes after 1st Fed rate hike in over 3 years
content: The Federal Reserve has set a new target range by increasing its benchmark interest rate, marking its first hike since 2023. President Donald Trump has called for a substantial reduction in interest rates, advocating for lower borrowing costs given the country's robust credit status. However, officials have stated that ongoing inflation remains a significant factor driving this adjustment.

title: Govt lowers export levies on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel
content: India's government has reduced export levies on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel.  The revised rates for these petroleum products took effect from September sixteenth.  Export duty on petrol decreased by one rupee to zero point five rupees per litre.  Diesel export levies were lowered by five rupees to twenty rupees per litre.  These changes reflect a reversal of higher rates implemented earlier this month.

title: Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,
content: After ten years in operation, Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down. Supported by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school was designed to provide essential services for low-income families. However, despite substantial funding, student outcomes frequently lagged behind state benchmarks. As the initiative pivots towards scientific research, this closure illustrates the difficulties faced by philanthropic educational endeavors.

title: 23-year-old Georgia mayor removed from office after misconduct allegations
content: In a surprising turn of events, Stockbridge's youngest mayor, Jayden Williams, was ousted following a misconduct hearing. The city council uncovered serious concerns surrounding his management of resources and city property. Facing claims of financial impropriety, Williams defended himself by pointing to insufficient training. Now, Stockbridge is preparing for a special election to choose a new mayor to bridge the leadership gap.

title: San Francisco woman invited strangers to picnic; 500 said yes, costs hit $4,000
content: What began as a casual picnic invitation in San Francisco has blossomed into a sprawling celebration attracting hundreds. The surge in interest led to the need for permits and enhanced safety measures, resulting in hefty costs for the organizer. Fortunately, Partiful has stepped in to cover these expenses, turning the picnic into a vibrant friendship festival for all attendees.

title: Massachusetts removed 2 old dams; 56 acres of wetlands were rebuilt by 2020
content: In a groundbreaking ecological revival, old dams on the Coonamessett River in Massachusetts were dismantled, restoring wetlands and providing passage for migratory fish. This project repurposed industrial farmland into a flourishing coastal ecosystem, allowing fish to ascend to upstream spawning spots that had been blocked for years. The restoration involved creating a sinuous stream channel and replacing a narrow culvert, establishing a model for agricultural bog transformations throughout New England.

title: Elon Musk’s Starlink mobile plan should be ‘laughed out of the room’, says T-Mobile CEO
content: T-Mobile's CFO Peter Osvaldik has raised concerns about the practicality of Starlink in the mobile sector, citing challenges posed by satellites in urban landscapes. He emphasizes the difficulties in deploying numerous small cell stations as envisioned by SpaceX. While Starlink aspires to bridge mobile service gaps in remote locations, T-Mobile sees significant obstacles in supplanting current cellular infrastructure, deeming it an uphill battle.

title: Meta admits mistake, to alert authorities on child sexual abuse material
content: The government is urging Meta to take more accountability for the online content shared on its platform. Following acknowledged shortcomings, Meta risks the loss of its intermediary safe harbour immunity. The company is now mandated to promptly report any instances of child sexual abuse material to the relevant authorities. The NCPCR highlighted that this safe harbour protection is conditional, not guaranteed.

title: Saudi in need, friend Pak missing in 'deed': Islamabad faces ultimate Mecca pact test
content: Saudi Arabia said on Wednesday that it had intercepted a Houthi drone heading towards Mecca, calling the security of Islam's holiest city a 'red line'. The Houthis flatly denied targeting Mecca and, in the same round of escalation, claimed to have shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet over Yemen's Marib province, a claim Riyadh has not confirmed.

title: Simone Biles’ $3M mansion: Why did she build her Texas dream home?
content: Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens’ Texas lakefront mansion is finally complete after years of planning, approvals and construction delays. The couple started designing the home in 2020 and finished it in November 2025. The reported $3 million property includes a private gym, pool, sports court, large kitchen, spa-style bathroom, laundry room and a dedicated space for their dogs.

title: Rafael Nadal vs Maria Francisca Perello net worth: Who is richer in 2026?
content: Rafael Nadal and Maria Francisca Perello have built a financially successful household in different ways. Nadal’s fortune is still considerably larger, thanks to tennis prize money, endorsements, investments and businesses built during and after his playing career. Perello has taken a lower-profile professional route, including work related to the Rafa Nadal Foundation, while supporting the family’s broader business and philanthropic pursuits.

title: 'Spider-Man' beats 'Star Wars' to become highest-grossing film in North America
content: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has now become the highest-grossing film domestically.  It surpassed Star Wars: The Force Awakens' long-standing box office record.  The film has grossed approximately USD 936.773 million in North America.  Globally, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has earned around USD 2.45 billion.  Marvel Studios and Sony plan future releases for the franchise.

title: Josh Duhamel turned 52 Minnesota acres into an off-grid family retreat
content: Actor Josh Duhamel has acquired a tranquil property in Minnesota, initially featuring just an old cabin. Over the years, he expanded the land to fifty-two acres, modernizing it with essential utilities like electricity and running water. This transformation has provided a beloved retreat for his family, where they can enjoy a range of outdoor activities, including leisure time by the lakeside with his son.

title: Trump praises PM Modi’s opium crackdown, but India stays on US drug transit list
content: President Trump welcomed Prime Minister Modi's efforts to curb opium poppy cultivation in India.  Washington designated India among 23 countries as major drug transit or producing nations.  This designation does not reflect a failure to tackle the drug trade by India.  The US seeks continued cooperation with India under the Drug Policy Framework.  Trump also urged China to strengthen action against precursor chemical flows.

title: Land sold for Rs 6.95cr, sister-in-law got Rs 72l; HC orders Rs 1.01cr plus interest
content: The property dispute was related to four women who jointly purchased land. Each held one-fourth undivided share. One of them later gave her brother-in-law a general power of attorney (GPA) because she was living in West Bengal, while he was based in Delhi.

title: US officials met Houthi leaders in Oman after Red Sea blitz, got assurances: Report
content: US officials reportedly met Houthi representatives in Oman on Sunday. The meeting occurred after Houthis occupied a significant portion of the Red Sea coast. Houthis affirmed no intention of attacking American vessels and committed to a 2025 ceasefire. They also stated they would not attack Israeli or commercial ships, except Saudi ones. This engagement follows months of negotiations and prior attacks on Red Sea shipping.

title: 'Inflation too high for too long': US Fed hikes interest rates for first time since 2023
content: The US Federal Reserve's hike decision comes on the back of persistent inflation and a broader increase in global borrowing costs. Inflation has remained stubbornly elevated, while borrowing costs around the world have moved higher.

title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered
content: Tyler Chambers embarked on an ambitious journey to construct his dream home in Washington. Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.

title: New Orleans turns 12 million pounds of glass into sand to rebuild wetlands
content: In a groundbreaking initiative in New Orleans, discarded glass bottles are being turned into sand for coastal restoration. Known as Glass Half Full, this program has successfully redirected millions of pounds of glass from local landfills. Current research is examining the positive impact of this recycled glass sand on the growth and durability of wetland vegetation, providing a creative solution to Louisiana's ongoing coastal land loss issues.

title: He moved to US for work, missed ITR; taxman imposes Rs 8.9L penalty - what ITAT said
content: The individual maintained that he had not deliberately attempted to evade tax. His case was that he had simply missed the ITR deadline while dealing with his relocation and new job in the US.

Additionally, the Rest of India roster for the upcoming Irani Cup has been released, featuring Rishabh Pant as the leader.

content: Xi fainted at the Brics summit, claims chairman of the China Democratic Party . he claims he returned to china on a special plane for medical treatment . the post claims that a military helicopter was used to transport him to a hospital . it also claims that an expert team at Beijing's 301 Hospital diagnosed him with a stroke .

title: US limits visas for South African officials over discrimination against White minorities
content: the restrictions would target people responsible for, or complicit in, policies involving race-based discrimination, uncompensated land seizures and incitement of violence against minority groups . the move comes as the Trump administration has repeatedly accused South Africa of discriminating against white people .

title: Houthis claim to have shot down Saudi F-15 jet with 'locally-made' missile - video
content: footage appears to show what the Houthis describe as a missile intercepting a fighter jet before showing the alleged crash site . the footage comes as Saudi Arabia faced heightened security concerns over potential threats to mecca amid an escalation in attacks by rebels .

title: Meet Benjamin Davis, 16, who turned 3D printer waste into reusable filament
content: student at bishop Feehan high school in attleboro, massa, built the machine as part of his science research project . the system uses waste plastic, including waste generated during 3D printing and converts it into filament that can again be fed into a 3D printer .

title: 'Severe damage': Pak vessel limps back to harbour after collision with Indian warship
content: incident happened on the evening of sept 15 in the north Arabian Sea . a pakistani naval ship closed a frontline Indian warship at high speed . the captain exercised extreme restraint by taking action to prevent a severe accident .

title: From Mecca's red line to the 'Gate of Tears': How US-Iran war is closing in on MBS
content: air defences intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone south of Mecca . the drone could enter the holy city's restricted airspace . a strike on or near Mecca could carry consequences that military and economic calculations cannot easily contain .

title: J&K cop accused of sexually exploiting constable gets bail from HC
content: a police sub-inspector is accused of sexually exploiting a constable on the false promises of marriage . the constable had alleged that the SI, Vikrant Kotwal, deliberately concealed his marital status to trap her into a relationship . he repeatedly promised to marry her in order to continue the sexual relationship even as he persuaded her to terminate two pregnancies .

title: At halfway mark of third term, PM Modi to hold 'Chintan Shivir'
content: the two-day Chintan Shivir is aimed at reviewing governance, improving coordination among ministries and shaping the government’s future agenda . the retreat will be held at Seva Teerth and comes almost midway through the third term of Modi-led NDA govt .

title: Indian couple win payout after suing UK home office for 'unlawful' immigration detention
content: the married couple, both Indian nationals, took legal action last year . they claimed being accommodated separately in male and female accommodation before planned removal was an "unlawful interference with their right to family life" the couple also challenged the refusal of their asylum claim in the uk .

title: Don’t trust Centre unless it’s a written deal, J&K CM tells Ladakhi delegation
content: CM Omar Abdullah said ladakhi representatives should not trust the centre on any assurance until it is in writing . he said that he fell victim to assurances that the statehood would be restored, which wasn’t SRINAGAR . the CM also alleged that J&K was assured that statehood will be restored .

title: Aggrieved party can seek deletion of court clips on socials: SC
content: supreme court says aggrieved person could seek a "takedown" order of content . if such footage was uploaded on social media, an advocate could approach authorities . advocate says unauthorised circulation of the proceedings violated his right to life, liberty, dignity and privacy .

title: Gang uses stolen hearse to cart away ATM with Rs 12 lakh
content: seven-member gang from west Bengal surveyed ATM kiosks for nearly a month before targeting one without a burglar alarm . three members of the gang have been arrested in Kerala, while four others are on the run . gang spotted a hearse parked on the roadside at Naduveerpattu and stole it to transport it .

title: NMDC discovers 27.29-carat diamond at Panna mine, its 2nd largest yet
content: a sparkling 27.29-carat gem-quality diamond has been discovered at NMDC Limited’s Panna mining project in Madhya Pradesh . the diamond was recovered on sept 15, 2026, from NMd’s Majhgawan mine in Panna . NMde officials indicated that the newly recovered diamond has initially been estimated to have a minimum auction price of around Rs 1 crore, but the final value could rise to Rs 2 crore .
